articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks from SWE-Bench Verified, with significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval. The model introduces a new 'structured planning' layer that exposes chain-of-thought traces developers can inspect and constrain via the API.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad-level problems in a controlled evaluation, surpassing the previous best AI result of 76%. The system combines a refined AlphaProof-style formal verification loop with large-scale language model reasoning, enabling it to generate and verify proofs end-to-end. Researchers noted this represents a qualitative shift toward AI systems that can perform genuinely novel mathematical reasoning rather than pattern-matching on training data.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Dexterous Manipulation for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated the third generation of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, now equipped with high-dexterity hands capable of handling irregularly shaped objects, transparent packaging, and fragile items at near-human speeds. The robot uses a transformer-based visuomotor policy trained on millions of simulated grasps and fine-tuned with real-world teleoperation data. Initial deployment partnerships with DHL and Amazon suggest commercial pilots will begin in Q1 2027 across distribution centers in the US and Germany.

articles.title: Figure AI's Humanoid Robot Achieves 20-Hour Autonomous Operation in BMW Factory Trial
articles.summary: Figure AI reported that its Figure 03 humanoid robot completed a 20-hour continuous autonomous shift at a BMW manufacturing plant in Spartanburg, South Carolina, performing bin picking, part inspection, and conveyor tending without human intervention. The robot leveraged on-device LLM-based task planning combined with reinforcement learning locomotion policies, recovering autonomously from 14 fault scenarios during the trial. This milestone marks the longest publicly documented fully autonomous humanoid deployment in a production manufacturing environment.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Real-Time Enterprise AI Safety Monitoring
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise safety framework called Constitutional Classifiers, which provides real-time monitoring and intervention for AI outputs in production systems. The system uses a hierarchy of lightweight classifier models trained against constitutional principles to flag policy violations, toxic outputs, and factual inconsistencies with sub-20ms latency overhead. Early adopters in financial services and healthcare report a 72% reduction in harmful outputs reaching end users compared to prompt-engineering-only guardrails.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started volume production on its N14G (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around nanosheet transistor process, achieving a 20% power efficiency improvement and 12% speed gain over its previous 2nm N2 node. The process is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators and mobile SoCs shipping in mid-2027, with Apple, Nvidia, and Qualcomm among the first customers. This advancement keeps TSMC ahead of Samsung Foundry and Intel in the race to extend Moore's Law into the sub-2nm era.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with 1.2 Trillion MoE Parameters and a Permissive Commercial License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4, a mixture-of-experts model with 1.2 trillion total parameters (approximately 140 billion active per forward pass), under an updated permissive license that removes previous revenue-cap restrictions for commercial use. The model matches or exceeds proprietary alternatives on coding, multilingual, and long-context benchmarks while running efficiently on clusters of 8 H100 GPUs using expert parallelism. The release includes full training recipes, RLHF data pipelines, and quantized variants down to 4-bit for on-premises deployment.

articles.title: Solid-State Battery Startup QuantumScape Ships First Commercial Cells to Volkswagen for EV Production
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced its first commercial shipment of solid-state lithium-metal battery cells to Volkswagen's PowerCo division for integration into production electric vehicles slated for 2027 model-year launches. The cells deliver approximately 450 Wh/kg energy density with 15-minute fast charging from 10% to 80%, representing a generational leap over conventional lithium-ion pouch cells. This milestone validates a technology that has been in development for over a decade and could reshape EV range expectations and charging infrastructure requirements.
